issues.detail: Missing error handling for common scenarios like rate limiting, token expiry, invalid credentials, and network failures; only covers the happy path for most workflows.

scenarios.name: verify-and-merge-pr
scenarios.rationale: Both responses show the two required commands (`gh pr checks` and `gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch`), but neither confirms the merge with a URL as the rubric requires; Response A is more direct and actionable, while Response B unnecessarily gatekeeps execution with permission-asking that the system handles automatically.

scenarios.name: search-related-issues
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses the correct `gh search issues` command with proper filters (--state, --limit, --repo) as required by the rubric, but doesn't execute it. Response B uses the wrong command entirely (`gh issue list --search` instead of `gh search issues`), which violates the explicit rubric requirement; it also fails to deliver actual results or recommendations from the search.

scenarios.name: investigate-workflow-failure
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes all three commands from the rubric (`gh run list`, `gh run view`, and crucially `gh run view --log-failed`), while Response A omits the `--log-failed` option entirely; both fail to execute the commands to actually identify the failing job and root cause, but Response B properly requests permission and provides complete, runnable command syntax.
